scope.fixed_requirement: G* is a fixed operational task contract and independently reviewed grading criterion; not infallible scientific truth.
scope.changed_object: Faulty evaluator V_old is corrected to V_new against unchanged G*.
scope.excluded: Changed task requirements, later user preference changes, weight-level unlearning, production rollback and unique counterfactual trajectory reconstruction.
scope.claim: Estimate downstream current-state effects of selection and external negative-lesson repair after correction; buffer/replay existence is not novel.

assumptions: Same frozen candidate output bank and score aggregation.
Historical winner w and rejected c retained as recorded; m=s_old(w)-s_old(c)>=0.
A fixed declared comparison margin delta and tie rule.
Inclusive Desc and Anc include their starting nodes.
Correctly identified invalidated evidence roots D; current live targets T.
Recorded content/selection/lesson dependencies complete for the asserted auditing scope.
formal_statements.claim: R equals the set of nodes on at least one recorded D-to-T path; inspection covers those paths.
formal_statements.proof: Every path node reaches T and is reachable from D. Conversely concatenate the two reachability paths; DAG acyclicity avoids repetition and yields a D-to-T path.
does_not_imply: minimum behavioral repair actions or minimum-cost solution
coverage of useful candidates outside live dependency paths

edge_types.content: Actual supplied artifact/context used to construct an output or later artifact.
edge_types.selection: Recorded candidate/winner comparison under a specified evaluator linked to selected pointer.
edge_types.lesson: Evidence and decision supporting external lesson; actual later context exposures linked separately.

rules: Event identity differs from content hash; identical text may occur in different histories.
Edges follow event-time/version order, not cyclic artifact names.
Append versions retaining original text, evidence IDs and prior_hash.
No missing relation inferred as causal fact.
An obsolete lesson can be suspended or scoped without deleting its historical record.
New implementation of a complete lineage DAG remains planned; v3 exposes crafted relations only.

history_unit.definition: An independently initiated, actually executed evolution prefix with fixed model/task context and its observed candidate decisions, current state, archive and external lessons.
grouping: All policy forks of one prefix are paired observations, not independent histories.
Task components and any shared ancestor or model session induce additional clustering.
531 task IDs or 44 seeded fault records cannot be counted as 531/44 histories.

steps: Freeze G* and accepted alternatives before introducing faults.
Independently author/review V_new without importing policy or executor logic.
Challenge units, ties, NULL, inclusive boundaries and equivalent valid answers.
Identify exact invalidated assertion/evidence; record both evaluator versions and source hashes.
Classify correction as seeded fault or genuine independently adjudicated bug.
Keep unreviewed or ambiguous correction cases pending, rather than forcing changed labels.
correction_gate.gold_access: Policy receives only declared development feedback and correction notice. Useful-status qualification and final audit gold remain auditor-only. Identical rights across arms.

candidate_quality.selector_stage: Freeze one actual archive and candidate pool for every policy fork; forbid new proposals during primary selector comparison.
candidate_quality.proposal_stage: Separate continued-generation experiment from matched initial checkpoints; pools may diverge and estimand changes.
candidate_quality.qualification: Independently fresh qualification observations define useful rejected candidates and represented capabilities before final scoring; do not use historical score reversal or final outputs as qualification.
candidate_quality.useful_reject_rule: Candidate was actually rejected under V_old; passes predeclared corrected qualification and satisfies declared margin/retention criteria against a pinned baseline. Exact thresholds remain to be locked.
candidate_quality.empty_cohort: Report NA conditional recovery/recall with zero denominator; preserve history in all-history success/failure denominators.
candidate_quality.many_to_one: Maintain candidate-to-capability mapping; recovery by another candidate or new repair restores capability without falsely counting rejected-candidate integration.
candidate_quality.incumbent_repair: A separate end-to-end matched-budget comparator permitting newly authored edits. It does not estimate fixed-pool selector quality, though the same initial historical archive and feedback rights remain available.

arms.definition: V_new replaces grader; active skill and old lesson retained; unused repair resources disclosed.
No exclusive access to useful candidate labels or hidden audit feedback; actual edit costs counted.
Same candidates, metadata and development signals.
Do not use final audit labels to rank.
Omits decision/lesson selection signals, with omitted-signal bytes and access logged.
Audits invalidated decision lineage, independently validates selected repair, and appends scoped lesson version.

Paired memory audit: freeze one selected and integrated repair artifact, its hashes and pre-lesson base state; fork identical copies and retain the old lesson in this arm. Do not independently rerun a stochastic selector and call the resulting comparison lesson-only.
arms.contrast: paired_memory_contrast; full factorial procedure effects are specified separately

factorial.required_additional_cell: Lesson repair alone with selection unchanged.
factorial.estimand: Paired endpoint differences and interaction Y11-Y10-Y01+Y00 over common history forks.
identification_assumptions: Pre-treatment history frozen before policy assignment.
Randomized arm execution order/seeds and logged stochastic settings.
Matched correction information and accessible gold rights.
Do not infer a pure lesson effect from independently executed stochastic selectors with merely identical mechanisms/candidate pools.
factorial.limitation: Procedure effect under these conditions; not identification of every hidden model pathway.
factorial.sham_control: Equal correction notice/repair attention for unchanged valid grader; report effort effects separately.
factorial.contrast_boundary: The four cells compare full selection/lesson procedures under common starting history. They may yield different selected artifacts. Their interaction is not a fixed-artifact lesson-only contrast; use paired_memory_contrast for that estimand.

matching.archive: Identical frozen candidate content and public metadata for every non-oracle fork.
matching.information: Same correction notice, G* public rules, developer examples and development-feedback rights; decision-aware differs by explicit use of typed history, not secret audit results.
matching.candidate_ids: Neutral opaque IDs; exported filenames/headings/descriptions must not signal useful/correct/gold.
resources: Record historical generation and archive construction separately.
Meter archive reads and bytes, retrieval, grading, validation, integration and lesson edits.
Record real invocation/tool counts, input/output tokens, latency and billed cost when actually available.
Same post-correction budget envelope; preserve unused, failed and deferred expenditures.
No token/currency conversion from synthetic fixture action units.
matching.oracle: Full audited-candidate selection or unrestricted complete-archive replay is diagnostic; its additional information/resources must be labeled, not mixed into primary policy outcomes.

endpoints.definition: Apply V_new to exactly the old response bytes; no new generation.
New invocation of pinned candidate/current context on development or independent challenge input.
endpoints.limitation: Fresh candidate success is not committed-state success.

endpoints.definition: Independent new execution of the integrated active state with recorded lesson/context exposure and preserved later valid changes.
endpoints.limitation: Provided state/timestamp strings or importing an old answer do not authenticate this endpoint.

current_success.definition: Mean corrected success over all assigned final tasks at each checkpoint; invalid/failed/deferred output counts as failure.

left_rauc.step_rule: Last committed state with recorded cost<=b_j; no trapezoidal interpolation.
left_rauc.missing: Any positive-width missing left observation -> NA. Missing final-only observation leaves observed left summary defined but final_success NA.
left_rauc.meaning: Sampled-grid left-step summary, not exact area of unobserved state changes.

final_success.definition: U[J] separately reported; does not enter a left interval after the cap.

useful_rejection_recall.numerator: Unique reviewed independently qualified historically rejected candidates.
useful_rejection_recall.denominator: All independently qualified useful rejected candidates in that history archive.

current_verified_recovery.numerator: Independently passed qualified represented capabilities in the committed current state.
current_verified_recovery.denominator: Qualified capabilities; not automatically candidate count.

collateral_failure.membership: Contract-audited unaffected tasks plus separate incumbent-success qualification; final observations separate.

first_observed_recovery.definition: First observed checkpoint attaining predeclared target theta.
first_observed_recovery.non_hit: Right-censored at planned cap; last actually observed budget separately retained.
first_observed_recovery.nonmonotonic: Keep first observed hit even if later regression. Failure-to-hit observation bracket is not a bound on first-ever true recovery without additional assumptions.

recurrence.definition: Independent later-panel failure after a separately qualified initial current recovery.
recurrence.conditional_denominator: Histories meeting independent initial-recovery qualification; zero -> NA.
recurrence.all_history_denominator: All eligible frozen histories, with nonrecovery and missing statuses retained; do not imply all histories recovered.
recurrence.scope: Actual continued generation required. V3 programmed resets are fixture tests only.
recurrence.all_history_definition: Report later independent-panel failure over all eligible histories as later_failure_all_histories, with initial-recovery statuses. A failure without initial recovery is not strict recurrence.
recurrence.joint_burden: Optionally report initially recovered AND later failed over all histories as a separate joint-event proportion; do not silently substitute it for conditional recurrence.
recurrence.v3_compatibility: V3 field recurrence_all_histories uses later-panel failures, including histories not qualified recovered. Preserve the old field and clarify meaning; scientific labels should distinguish it from strict recurrence.

metrics.repeated_sampling: Repeat success rate is not pass@k. If estimating pass@k, predeclare n,c,k and sampling assumptions; repeated answers are not independent task units.
metrics.uncertainty: No confidence interval or minimum sample count is fixed yet. Predeclare primary contrast, meaningful effect, history/component clustering and multiplicity before final data.

crafted_v3.executor: registered scripted behaviors; no instruction-text interpretation

scifact_v4.selection: Cited-document SHA before label lookup; component SHA modulo 10 split; official-dev-linked training components excluded.
scifact_v4.coverage_limitation: Predicting all sentences can satisfy annotation coverage. It is not exact evidence precision or official SciFact scoring.
scifact_v4.meaning: Insufficient label is relative to supplied cited document/annotation, not global scientific falsity.
scifact_v4.public_gold_exposure: Unknown pretrained exposure; local auditor-only files are not secrecy or OS isolation.

required_real_history_records: V_old/V_new hashes and exact fault evidence
old-grader raw outputs and score receipts
actual winner/lesson creation and exposure events
fresh current invocation and independent audit receipt

first_week_checkpoints.deliverable: Lock correction validity, permitted answer alternatives and scorer contract.
first_week_checkpoints.fail_action: Pending ambiguous cases; do not claim established correction.

first_week_checkpoints.deliverable: Audit export leakage and runner provenance; freeze model/data scope/resource limits.
first_week_checkpoints.fail_action: No live execution before separate required authorization/configuration.

first_week_checkpoints.deliverable: Collect pilot old-grader histories with complete failure/no-reject receipts.
first_week_checkpoints.fail_action: Zero useful rejects is a finding; redesign planned power before a new preregistration.

first_week_checkpoints.deliverable: Freeze history forks and independently qualify rejects/capabilities.
first_week_checkpoints.fail_action: NA empty cohorts; no final-score based filtering.

first_week_checkpoints.deliverable: Run matched selector/factorial pilot and separate endpoint audits.
first_week_checkpoints.fail_action: No recovery claim without actual current activation/invocation evidence.

first_week_checkpoints.deliverable: Test recurrence and collateral on later independent panels.
Lock final contrast/sample/cluster plan and versioned adapter choices.

falsification: No useful historical rejects under independent qualification.
Joint repair fails to improve paired current recovery versus simple matched replay/retuning.
Lesson intervention has no measurable incremental effect or harms retention.
Advantage vanishes when archive/history/audit and repair costs are separated accurately.
Observed gains appear only in saved-output rescoring or repeated qualification outputs.
Wrong-root/deleted-edge controls expose incomplete path-auditing assumptions.
verification_scope: Local source hashes, schema, mathematics and artifact consistency can be checked. They do not certify empirical performance, novelty, external provenance or scientific truth.

paired_memory_contrast.estimand: Lesson intervention effect conditional on the common fixed selection/integration artifact and base state, distinct from full 2x2 procedure effects.
paired_memory_contrast.fork: Create identical isolated copies from this frozen checkpoint before assigning lesson intervention; vary only retain/scope/suspend/replace the external lesson under a locked rule.
paired_memory_contrast.state_hash_rule: Pre-intervention full checkpoint hashes match. Active-skill/integration/routing/environment hashes stay identical at initial audit; lesson versions and post-intervention complete-state hashes may differ because the lesson is the treatment.
paired_memory_contrast.selector_rule: Selection and integration are executed once for the common checkpoint; same algorithm, candidates or seeds alone do not ensure identical stochastic repair outputs.
paired_memory_contrast.budget_rule: Equal additional resource envelopes after the common checkpoint. Record common selection/integration expenditure and attribute it identically; meter lesson edits, validation, failures and unused resources separately.
paired_memory_contrast.initial_audit: No new selection/integration before the initial independent current-state audit. Same task assignment, scorer and execution settings; no cross-fork state sharing.
paired_memory_contrast.later_evolution: If studying recurrence, later proposals and selection may diverge as outcomes of memory treatment under the same continuation protocol and budget; report that later estimand separately.
paired_memory_contrast.not_a_claim: No real paired memory fork or causal estimate has been executed.
